<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="出勤時登録">f5fb8c8bc374f21058a9d5fc05013113</cat_item><cat_variable>IO:0eaff30fc3b0761058a9d5fc05013124</cat_variable><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>Endtime Set</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[function onSubmit() {
  var srcVal = g_form.getValue('work_start_time_disp'); 

  var ms = getDateFromFormat(srcVal, g_user_date_time_format);
  if (!ms) {
    g_form.addErrorMessage('開始時刻の形式が不正です。');
    return false;
  }

  var dt = new Date(ms);
  dt.setHours(dt.getHours() + 9);

  var outStr = formatDateServer(dt, g_user_date_time_format);
  g_form.setValue('work_end_time_disp', outStr);

  return true; 

}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin_komoto</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-12-12 02:28:08</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>7860e5c5c3f136108568f1d4e4013187</sys_id><sys_mod_count>11</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Endtime Set</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="勤怠時間管理" source="x_1813832_0">531f7b72c334f21058a9d5fc05013198</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="勤怠時間管理">531f7b72c334f21058a9d5fc05013198</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_7860e5c5c3f136108568f1d4e4013187</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin_komoto</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-12-12 08:12:12</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onSubmit</type><ui_type>0</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>true</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="出勤時登録">f5fb8c8bc374f21058a9d5fc05013113</cat_item><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>calender check</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[// Type: onLoad
// Applies to: このRecord Producer
function onLoad() {
    var fieldName = 'work_start_tim0'; // 勤務開始時間フィールドの変数名に合わせて変更

    // 今月の月初 00:00:00 を作成
    var start = new GlideDateTime();         // 現在日時（クライアントTZ）
    start.setDayOfMonth(1);                  // 月初
    start.setTime('00:00:00');               // 時刻クリア

    // 来月の月初 00:00:00 を作成し、1秒戻して今月末 23:59:59 を得る
    var end = new GlideDateTime(start);      // コピー
    end.addMonthsUTC(1);                     // 来月へ（TZ差の影響を避けるならUTCで加算）
    end.addSecondsUTC(-1);                   // 1秒戻す → 今月最終日の 23:59:59

    // カレンダー選択可能範囲をセット
    g_form.setDateRange(fieldName, start, end);
}
]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin_komoto_ryota</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-11-12 02:44:22</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>39740bd3c381321058a9d5fc05013105</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>calender check</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="勤怠時間管理" source="x_1813832_0">531f7b72c334f21058a9d5fc05013198</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="勤怠時間管理">531f7b72c334f21058a9d5fc05013198</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_39740bd3c381321058a9d5fc05013105</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin_komoto_ryota</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-11-12 02:57:26</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onLoad</type><ui_type>0</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>

	if (gs.hasRole('admin')) {
		return;
	}

	var gr = new GlideRecord('x_1813832_0_working_hours_table');
	gr.addQuery('user_name',current.user_name);
	gr.addQuery('work_start_tim0', '>=', gs.beginningOfToday());
	gr.addQuery('work_start_tim0', '<=', gs.endOfToday());
	gr.query();
	if(gr.next()) {
		gs.addErrorMessage('本日はすでに出勤登録済みです。');
		current.setAbortAction(true);
	}
})(current, previous);

function evaluateProperty({ api }) {
	const playbooksByContextId = api.data.playbook_custom_layout.playbooksByContextId;

	if (!playbooksByContextId || !Object.keys(playbooksByContextId).length)
		return;

	const playbookItems = Object.values(playbooksByContextId).map(
		({ sysId, title }) => {
			if (!sysId || !title) return;

			return {
				id: sysId,
				label: title
			};
		}
	);

	return playbookItems;
}
]]></script><script_api_version>2.0.0</script_api_version><sys_class_name>sys_ux_client_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin_fujisawa_shouma</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-12-15 06:34:32</sys_created_on><sys_id>248b6982c3713e108568f1d4e401318d</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>playbook_picker/items</sys_name><sys_package display_value="勤怠時間管理" source="x_1813832_0">531f7b72c334f21058a9d5fc05013198</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="勤怠時間管理">531f7b72c334f21058a9d5fc05013198</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ux_client_script_248b6982c3713e108568f1d4e401318d</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin_fujisawa_shouma</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-12-15 06:34:32</sys_updated_on><target>macroponent</target><type>transform</type></sys_ux_client_script></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>false</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_1813832_0_working_hours_table</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Work Time Calc</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/ ) {
    gs.info('BR開始: ' + current.getDisplayValue('number'));
    if (current.work_start_time && current.work_end_time) {
        var startDate = new GlideDateTime(current.work_start_time);
        var endDate = new GlideDateTime(current.work_end_time);
		console.log(startDate);
		console.log(endDate);
        var diffMillis = endDate.getNumericValue() - startDate.getNumericValue();
        var hours = diffMillis / (1000 * 60 * 60);
        // current.work_time = parseFloat(hours.toFixed(1));
        current.work_time = parseFloat(math.round(hours*2)/2);
        if (current.work_time >= 8) {
            current.work_time += -1;
        }
        gs.info('労働時間計算完了: ' + current.work_time);
    }
})();]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin_komoto_ryota</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-11-06 07:56:51</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>d3d29d25c349321058a9d5fc05013132</sys_id><sys_mod_count>25</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Work Time Calc</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="勤怠時間管理" source="x_1813832_0">531f7b72c334f21058a9d5fc05013198</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="勤怠時間管理">531f7b72c334f21058a9d5fc05013198</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_d3d29d25c349321058a9d5fc05013132</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin_komoto</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-12-12 03:04:46</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=d3d29d25c349321058a9d5fc05013132"/><sys_translated_text action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><documentkey>d3d29d25c349321058a9d5fc05013132</documentkey><fieldname>message</fieldname><language>ja</language><sys_created_by>admin_fujisawa_shouma</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-11-18 00:29:01</sys_created_on><sys_id>547fddd583d97210c386e5d0deaad339</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_updated_by>admin_fujisawa_shouma</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-11-18 00:29:01</sys_updated_on><tablename>sys_script</tablename><value/></sys_translated_text></record_update>

  * @param {params} params
  * @param {api} params.api
  * @param {TransformApiHelpers} params.helpers
  */

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="catalog_script_client"><catalog_script_client action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>false</active><applies_catalog>true</applies_catalog><applies_extended>false</applies_extended><applies_req_item>false</applies_req_item><applies_sc_task>false</applies_sc_task><applies_target_record>false</applies_target_record><applies_to>item</applies_to><cat_item display_value="出勤時登録">f5fb8c8bc374f21058a9d5fc05013113</cat_item><cat_variable/><condition/><description/><field/><global>true</global><isolate_script>true</isolate_script><messages/><name>check submit time</name><order/><published_ref/><script><![CDATA[// Type: onSubmit
// Applies to: このRecord Producer
function onSubmit() {
    var fieldName = 'work_start_tim0';

    var val = g_form.getValue(fieldName);
    if (!val) return true; // 未入力は別途カタログUIポリシー等で必須制御

    var input = new GlideDateTime(val); // 入力値（文字列でもOK）

    // 今月の範囲（onLoadと同条件）を再計算
    var start = new GlideDateTime();
    start.setDayOfMonth(1);
    start.setTime('00:00:00');

    var end = new GlideDateTime(start);
    end.addMonthsUTC(1);
    end.addSecondsUTC(-1);

    // 範囲判定（start <= input <= end）
    if (input.compareTo(start) < 0 || input.compareTo(end) > 0) {
        var msg = '勤務開始時間は「今月内（' + start.getDisplayValue() + ' ～ ' + end.getDisplayValue() + '）」のみ選択・入力可能です。';
        g_form.addErrorMessage(msg);
        return false; // 送信中止
    }

    return true; // 許可
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin_komoto_ryota</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-11-12 02:49:47</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>05e5cbdfc381321058a9d5fc050131d2</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>check submit time</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="勤怠時間管理" source="x_1813832_0">531f7b72c334f21058a9d5fc05013198</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="勤怠時間管理">531f7b72c334f21058a9d5fc05013198</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_05e5cbdfc381321058a9d5fc050131d2</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin_komoto_ryota</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-11-12 02:57:26</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onSubmit</type><ui_type>0</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
